conf.description: Azure Activity Logs (Government subscription) service-health / json: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: azure-activity / service-health / json. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Azure Logs integration (azure.activitylogs data stream)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
